posts.title: On the Images used in the OP Elevator Pitch
posts.description: I built the elevator pitch for the release of OP 0.5 in a semi-fugue, and once I settled on only using Wikimedia, things moved pretty fast. Each image I used struck me as something remarkable at the time. It wasn’t until going back through to do proper attributions that I realized how interesting each one of them is.

posts.title: Teaching the Rad Web – Again
posts.description: The first Make Radical Websites workshop was so fun, I was determined to do it again. The main thing I learned is that, just like when I run DnD, I packed way more than the students or I could realistically get through into one session.
